obligations.note: The markDocumentReceived method is a state-changing operation (it calls loanCase.markReceived and store.save), yet the diff removes the audit.record call and replaces it with a plain log.info. The state change is no longer recorded as an audit event with actor, action, target, and time, directly violating the obligation that every state-changing operation records an audit event.

The new log.info line logs only a DocumentType enum value and a case ID (e.g. 'HW-000123'); neither is NPI (SSN, tax id, account/routing number, date of birth, or income). No unmasked NPI enters the log.

Ticket CHG-24651 is type 'standard', status 'approved' by grace.kim@fernbrook.example (a change_manager), and its components list includes 'mortgage.cases', which is the component of the changed file CaseService.java per controls/mortgage/components.json.

The single code_review approval is from wen.li@fernbrook.example (p-wli), who holds the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author nneka.okafor@fernbrook.example (p-nokafor).
The approval names commit c6e2c916…, which is the sole and head commit of the change; no later commits exist to void it.

CI ran on the final commit c6e2c916… with 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. All mortgage control tests in the registry (AccessMatrix, Routes, Session, Encryption, Logging, Audit, Retention, Approvals, Underwriting) are present and passing.
CaseService.java maps to component 'mortgage.cases', which is marked security_sensitive: false in controls/mortgage/components.json; no security_review approval is required.
The only changed file is CaseService.java, which is not under any protected path listed in controls/protected-paths.json (controls/*, test controls, CI). No control_owner approval is needed.

The change creates a deviation from product obligation AUD-1 (removing an audit record from a state-changing operation). The exception register contains no entry for AUD-1, and the one AUD-1-related entry does not exist; therefore the deviation has no approved, in-scope, unexpired exception with a compensating control.

No entry in the acceptance ledger covers CaseService.java (the ledger entries cover Approvals.java, Underwriting.java, Policy.java, audit.py, payments.py, routes.py). The change to CaseService.java therefore lapses no previously accepted evidence.

summary: The change replaces the audit.record call in the markDocumentReceived method with a plain log.info, removing the audit event for a state-changing operation (marking a document received and persisting the case). This directly violates AUD-1, which requires every state-changing operation to record an audit event with actor, action, target, and time. No exception in the register covers this deviation, so EXC-1 is also unsatisfied. All process obligations (ticket, independent approval, CI, security-review scope, protected-path checks, evidence-lapse) are met, but the product-obligation violation is decisive. The change must be rejected until the audit recording is restored.
